defaultGoal: Maintain independence with personal care and respect the resident’s preferred routines, timing and choices.
caregiverTasks: Allow resident to complete bathing, dressing, grooming, toileting and eating independently.
Set out preferred toiletries/clothing only if requested.
Respect usual timing, sequence, privacy and cultural preferences.
Observe for new difficulty, fatigue, pain or decline during self-care.
nurseOversight: Confirm baseline and review only when a change or exception is reported. Validate functional assistance level; review pain, fatigue, skin findings and change from baseline.
suggestedFrequency: Routine observation; assistance only on request
escalationTrigger: New hands-on assistance, repeated missed hygiene, pain, fatigue or safety concern.
activationRule: Recommend only when the assessed need is active and requires staff action; nurse individualizes and approves before activation.

defaultGoal: Maintain independence with self-care, providing occasional setup or cueing as needed while respecting preferred routines and choices.
caregiverTasks: Provide setup for selected ADLs (e.g., clothing, toiletries, meal tray).
Give one-step reminders or verbal cueing only when needed.
Encourage resident to complete remaining steps independently.
Document which ADLs needed cueing/setup and any change from baseline.
nurseOversight: Confirm the individualized plan and review recurring exceptions. Validate functional assistance level; review pain, fatigue, skin findings and change from baseline.
escalationTrigger: Need for regular physical help, repeated incomplete ADLs or increased fatigue.
activationRule: Recommend only when the assessed need is active and requires staff action; nurse individualizes and approves before activation.

defaultGoal: Maximize participation in personal care while providing regular hands-on assistance as needed. Maintain privacy, dignity and preferred routines.
caregiverTasks: Provide hands-on help for identified ADLs while allowing resident to perform safe steps.
Use agreed transfer/body mechanics during bathing, dressing and toileting.
Offer simple choices for clothing, grooming and timing.
Check skin and comfort during personal care and report concerns.
nurseOversight: Establish planned monitoring and review trends at least daily or as ordered. Validate functional assistance level; review pain, fatigue, skin findings and change from baseline.
escalationTrigger: Assistance expands to multiple ADLs, two-person help becomes necessary, or resident cannot participate safely.
activationRule: Recommend only when the assessed need is active and requires staff action; nurse individualizes and approves before activation.

defaultGoal: Encourage the resident to participate in personal care to the extent safely possible while providing extensive assistance across needed ADLs. Preserve dignity and personal choices.
caregiverTasks: Provide extensive hands-on assistance across multiple ADLs using a consistent sequence.
Prepare all supplies before care and cluster tasks to reduce fatigue.
Encourage participation in any safe step (face washing, arm through sleeve, self-feeding portions).
Complete post-care comfort, hygiene and skin checks.
nurseOversight: Review each shift/day according to risk, coordinate interventions, and reassess deterioration. Validate functional assistance level; review pain, fatigue, skin findings and change from baseline.
escalationTrigger: Near-total dependence, distress with care, new swallowing/feeding dependence or care exceeds staffing plan.
activationRule: Recommend only when the assessed need is active and requires staff action; nurse individualizes and approves before activation.

defaultGoal: Maintain comfort, dignity and personal preferences during all personal care. Encourage any safe participation despite extensive dependence.
caregiverTasks: Provide near-total/total assistance for personal care while protecting privacy and dignity.
Use two-person/mechanical assistance when required by the care plan and trained staff.
Reposition and provide comfort measures during/after care.
Offer meaningful choices and observe non-verbal signs of pain or distress.
nurseOversight: Provide intensive nursing oversight; review each shift and evaluate MLR, DT-013, DT-014 and service capability. Validate functional assistance level; review pain, fatigue, skin findings and change from baseline.
escalationTrigger: Pain, skin breakdown, recurrent care refusal, unsafe transfer needs or needs beyond service capability.
activationRule: Recommend only when the assessed need is active and requires staff action; nurse individualizes and approves before activation.

defaultGoal: Maintain safe, independent mobility and transfers at the resident’s preferred pace and routine.
caregiverTasks: Encourage independent walking and transfers at usual pace.
Keep usual mobility route uncluttered and footwear accessible.
Ensure commonly used items are within safe reach.
Observe for new gait, endurance or transfer changes.
nurseOversight: Confirm baseline and review only when a change or exception is reported. Assess gait, transfers and tolerance; approve safe-handling technique/equipment and coordinate PT/OT when indicated.
escalationTrigger: New unsteadiness, fall/near-fall, dizziness or need for physical assistance.
activationRule: Recommend only when the assessed need is active and requires staff action; nurse individualizes and approves before activation.

defaultGoal: Maintain safe mobility with appropriate device, setup or intermittent standby assistance while preserving independence.
caregiverTasks: Set up prescribed mobility device before ambulation.
Provide standby assistance for transfers or longer walks as identified.
Remind resident to use device/handrails and appropriate footwear.
Document episodes requiring more than standby help.
nurseOversight: Confirm the individualized plan and review recurring exceptions. Assess gait, transfers and tolerance; approve safe-handling technique/equipment and coordinate PT/OT when indicated.
escalationTrigger: Recurring contact guard, transfer difficulty, near-falls or reduced endurance.
activationRule: Recommend only when the assessed need is active and requires staff action; nurse individualizes and approves before activation.

defaultGoal: Promote safe mobility and transfers with supervision, contact guard or minimal assistance as needed. Encourage active participation and independence.
caregiverTasks: Provide recurring supervision/contact guard or minimal assist for transfers and ambulation.
Use the same transfer technique and cue sequence across staff.
Position mobility device correctly before standing/sitting.
Monitor gait, balance, fatigue and dizziness during mobility.
nurseOversight: Establish planned monitoring and review trends at least daily or as ordered. Assess gait, transfers and tolerance; approve safe-handling technique/equipment and coordinate PT/OT when indicated.
escalationTrigger: Need for substantial physical help, two-person transfer, recurrent buckling or falls.
activationRule: Recommend only when the assessed need is active and requires staff action; nurse individualizes and approves before activation.

defaultGoal: Maintain safe mobility and transfers using the established assistance level, technique and equipment while encouraging participation as tolerated.
caregiverTasks: Provide substantial physical assistance for transfers and frequent mobility help.
Use gait belt/device only if approved by policy/care plan and staff are trained.
Plan toileting/meals to reduce unnecessary high-risk transfers.
Coordinate mobility technique with nurse/PT/OT and document tolerance.
nurseOversight: Review each shift/day according to risk, coordinate interventions, and reassess deterioration. Assess gait, transfers and tolerance; approve safe-handling technique/equipment and coordinate PT/OT when indicated.
escalationTrigger: Unsafe one-person transfer, rapid decline, new neurologic deficit or inability to bear weight.
activationRule: Recommend only when the assessed need is active and requires staff action; nurse individualizes and approves before activation.

defaultGoal: Ensure safe and comfortable transfers and mobility with extensive assistance while preserving dignity, comfort and any remaining functional ability.
caregiverTasks: Provide extensive transfer/mobility support according to the established safe-handling plan.
Use mechanical/two-person transfer when required and available within capability.
Reposition regularly and support comfort in bed/chair.
Check for pain, skin pressure and tolerance after transfers.
nurseOversight: Provide intensive nursing oversight; review each shift and evaluate MLR, DT-013, DT-014 and service capability. Assess gait, transfers and tolerance; approve safe-handling technique/equipment and coordinate PT/OT when indicated.
escalationTrigger: New pain/injury, inability to transfer safely with current resources or equipment failure.
activationRule: Recommend only when the assessed need is active and requires staff action; nurse individualizes and approves before activation.

defaultGoal: Maintain safe independent mobility using routine fall-prevention measures and a safe environment.
caregiverTasks: Maintain clear pathways, adequate lighting and safe footwear.
Keep call system/personal items within reach.
Encourage usual safe mobility habits.
Record any new fall or near-fall.
nurseOversight: Confirm baseline and review only when a change or exception is reported. Review falls/near-falls and contributing clinical, medication and environmental factors; update prevention plan.
escalationTrigger: Any fall/near-fall or newly identified fall-risk factor.
activationRule: Recommend only when the assessed need is active and requires staff action; nurse individualizes and approves before activation.

defaultGoal: Maintain safe mobility and prevent falls through routine precautions while preserving independence.
caregiverTasks: Complete routine fall-prevention check each shift/day per policy.
Remind resident to use mobility device and avoid rushing.
Ensure room/bathroom setup supports safe movement.
Review any near-fall for contributing factors.
nurseOversight: Confirm the individualized plan and review recurring exceptions. Review falls/near-falls and contributing clinical, medication and environmental factors; update prevention plan.
escalationTrigger: Repeated near-falls, new gait/balance concern or need for individualized precautions.
activationRule: Recommend only when the assessed need is active and requires staff action; nurse individualizes and approves before activation.

defaultGoal: Reduce fall risk through individualized precautions, appropriate assistance and monitoring of gait, balance and contributing factors.
caregiverTasks: Implement individualized fall precautions documented in the care plan.
Provide assistance for identified high-risk activities (toileting, transfers, showering).
Monitor gait, balance, footwear, device use and environmental contributors.
Review medications/clinical contributors with nurse when risk changes.
nurseOversight: Establish planned monitoring and review trends at least daily or as ordered. Review falls/near-falls and contributing clinical, medication and environmental factors; update prevention plan.
escalationTrigger: Fall with injury, increasing supervision need, acute confusion or recurrent unsafe mobility.
activationRule: Recommend only when the assessed need is active and requires staff action; nurse individualizes and approves before activation.

defaultGoal: Prevent falls and injury through regular supervision or assistance during identified risk activities while supporting safe mobility.
caregiverTasks: Provide regular supervision/assistance during mobility and identified risk periods.
Schedule proactive toileting and respond promptly to mobility needs.
Use individualized cues/redirection to prevent unsafe unassisted movement.
Complete post-fall/near-fall review and update interventions.
nurseOversight: Review each shift/day according to risk, coordinate interventions, and reassess deterioration. Review falls/near-falls and contributing clinical, medication and environmental factors; update prevention plan.
escalationTrigger: Recurrent falls despite plan, new injury, significant decline or need for near-continuous supervision.
activationRule: Recommend only when the assessed need is active and requires staff action; nurse individualizes and approves before activation.

defaultGoal: Minimize falls and injury through intensive individualized prevention, close supervision and the least restrictive safety measures appropriate to the resident.
caregiverTasks: Maintain intensive individualized fall-prevention plan using least restrictive measures.
Provide close supervision during all high-risk mobility/transfers.
Use team handoff of current triggers, safest techniques and recent events.
Escalate promptly after falls, head impact, acute change or inability to maintain safety.
nurseOversight: Provide intensive nursing oversight; review each shift and evaluate MLR, DT-013, DT-014 and service capability. Review falls/near-falls and contributing clinical, medication and environmental factors; update prevention plan.
escalationTrigger: Any serious injury, repeated uncontrolled falls or safety need beyond service capability.
activationRule: Recommend only when the assessed need is active and requires staff action; nurse individualizes and approves before activation.

defaultGoal: Maintain autonomy, self-direction and participation in daily decisions and preferred routines.
caregiverTasks: Offer normal choices and involve resident directly in decisions.
Maintain preferred routine and access to calendar/clock as desired.
Communicate changes in schedule clearly.
Observe for acute confusion or new memory difficulty.
nurseOversight: Confirm baseline and review only when a change or exception is reported. Assess cognition and decision capacity; distinguish baseline dementia from acute confusion/delirium; approve cueing and decision-support approach.
escalationTrigger: Acute change in cognition, unsafe judgment or new difficulty self-directing care.
activationRule: Recommend only when the assessed need is active and requires staff action; nurse individualizes and approves before activation.

defaultGoal: Support independence and orientation with occasional reminders or cueing while allowing adequate time for decision-making.
caregiverTasks: Give occasional reminders for appointments, meals or daily routine.
Use one-step cueing when resident loses track of a task.
Allow extra processing time before repeating instructions.
Document new or increasing cueing needs.
nurseOversight: Confirm the individualized plan and review recurring exceptions. Assess cognition and decision capacity; distinguish baseline dementia from acute confusion/delirium; approve cueing and decision-support approach.

activationRule: Recommend only when the assessed need is active and requires staff action; nurse individualizes and approves before activation.

defaultGoal: Maintain participation in daily routines through regular cueing, reorientation and support with decisions while respecting the resident’s choices.
caregiverTasks: Provide regular cueing/reorientation using familiar language and routines.
Offer limited, simple choices to preserve decision-making.
Supervise decisions involving safety, medication and high-risk activities as care plan indicates.
Use consistent staff approaches and document effective cues.
nurseOversight: Establish planned monitoring and review trends at least daily or as ordered. Assess cognition and decision capacity; distinguish baseline dementia from acute confusion/delirium; approve cueing and decision-support approach.
escalationTrigger: Substantial impairment across multiple daily decisions, wandering/unsafe behavior or acute change.
activationRule: Recommend only when the assessed need is active and requires staff action; nurse individualizes and approves before activation.

defaultGoal: Promote comfort and participation through structured routines, simple choices, familiar approaches and substantial support with daily-care decisions.
caregiverTasks: Use structured daily routine and repeated simple cues for most care activities.
Break tasks into one-step directions and demonstrate when helpful.
Anticipate needs when resident cannot reliably plan/sequence care.
Record behavior/cognition patterns that affect care delivery.
nurseOversight: Review each shift/day according to risk, coordinate interventions, and reassess deterioration. Assess cognition and decision capacity; distinguish baseline dementia from acute confusion/delirium; approve cueing and decision-support approach.

activationRule: Recommend only when the assessed need is active and requires staff action; nurse individualizes and approves before activation.

defaultGoal: Maintain comfort, dignity and familiarity through consistent routines, simple communication and pervasive support with daily care and decision-making.

Use simple language, non-verbal cues and consistent familiar routines.
Anticipate basic needs while still offering simple choices and seeking assent.
Monitor non-verbal indicators of pain, fear, hunger or toileting need.
nurseOversight: Provide intensive nursing oversight; review each shift and evaluate MLR, DT-013, DT-014 and service capability. Assess cognition and decision capacity; distinguish baseline dementia from acute confusion/delirium; approve cueing and decision-support approach.

activationRule: Recommend only when the assessed need is active and requires staff action; nurse individualizes and approves before activation.

defaultGoal: Maintain emotional well-being, meaningful relationships, preferred activities and usual routines.

activationRule: Recommend only when the assessed need is active and requires staff action; nurse individualizes and approves before activation.

defaultGoal: Maintain emotional comfort with occasional reassurance or redirection while respecting preferences and usual coping strategies.

Use known calming activities and preferred communication style.
Identify and document triggers when episodes occur.
Return resident to preferred activity/routine after distress resolves.
nurseOversight: Confirm the individualized plan and review recurring exceptions. Assess behavior pattern, triggers, unmet needs and possible clinical causes; approve non-pharmacologic plan and review PRN use/orders.

activationRule: Recommend only when the assessed need is active and requires staff action; nurse individualizes and approves before activation.

defaultGoal: Promote emotional stability through predictable routines, reassurance and individualized approaches that reduce known triggers and distress.

Use individualized reassurance, redirection and de-escalation plan.
Offer meaningful activity matched to ability and preference.
Document antecedent, behavior, response and effective intervention.
nurseOversight: Establish planned monitoring and review trends at least daily or as ordered. Assess behavior pattern, triggers, unmet needs and possible clinical causes; approve non-pharmacologic plan and review PRN use/orders.
escalationTrigger: Increasing frequency/intensity, staff safety concern, care refusal with health impact or acute behavior change.
activationRule: Recommend only when the assessed need is active and requires staff action; nurse individualizes and approves before activation.

defaultGoal: Reduce distress and maintain safety through frequent individualized reassurance, redirection and de-escalation while preserving dignity and choice.
caregiverTasks: Provide frequent individualized de-escalation/redirection and close follow-through.
Assign consistent approaches and communicate triggers/effective responses at handoff.
Modify environment/activity promptly when distress escalates.
Coordinate clinical review for new or worsening behavior.
nurseOversight: Review each shift/day according to risk, coordinate interventions, and reassess deterioration. Assess behavior pattern, triggers, unmet needs and possible clinical causes; approve non-pharmacologic plan and review PRN use/orders.
escalationTrigger: Injury risk, uncontrolled aggression, rapid behavior change or need for continuous one-to-one support.
activationRule: Recommend only when the assessed need is active and requires staff action; nurse individualizes and approves before activation.

defaultGoal: Maintain safety, comfort and dignity through intensive person-centered behavioral support using individualized triggers, calming strategies and the least restrictive approach.
caregiverTasks: Implement intensive person-centered behavior support plan using least restrictive approaches.
Maintain high consistency of routine, staffing approach and environment.
Use proactive comfort checks and individualized calming/sensory strategies.
Escalate urgently when behavior suggests pain, delirium, medication effect or imminent harm.
nurseOversight: Provide intensive nursing oversight; review each shift and evaluate MLR, DT-013, DT-014 and service capability. Assess behavior pattern, triggers, unmet needs and possible clinical causes; approve non-pharmacologic plan and review PRN use/orders.
escalationTrigger: Imminent harm, unmanageable distress or behavior needs beyond service capability.
activationRule: Recommend only when the assessed need is active and requires staff action; nurse individualizes and approves before activation.

defaultGoal: Maintain current health and wellness through routine observation and healthy daily routines.

Encourage usual hydration, nutrition, activity and rest.
Record significant change from baseline.
Follow routine preventive/medical appointments as scheduled.
nurseOversight: Confirm baseline and review only when a change or exception is reported. Set resident-specific monitoring parameters from current orders; interpret trends and manage change-of-condition escalation.

activationRule: Recommend only when the assessed need is active and requires staff action; nurse individualizes and approves before activation.

Record ordered measurements and symptoms in the designated record.
Reinforce condition-specific self-management instructions within care scope.
Notify nurse/provider of readings/symptoms outside ordered parameters.

Coordinate appointments/labs and ensure results/orders are communicated.

activationRule: Recommend only when the assessed need is active and requires staff action; nurse individualizes and approves before activation.

Compare current findings with resident-specific baseline and ordered parameters.
Coordinate medication, nutrition, hydration and appointment issues with nurse/provider.
Provide clear shift-to-shift handoff of active clinical concerns.
nurseOversight: Review each shift/day according to risk, coordinate interventions, and reassess deterioration. Set resident-specific monitoring parameters from current orders; interpret trends and manage change-of-condition escalation.

activationRule: Recommend only when the assessed need is active and requires staff action; nurse individualizes and approves before activation.

Maintain active interdisciplinary coordination and explicit escalation thresholds.
Document response to interventions and unresolved abnormalities.
Initiate emergency/transfer process when criteria are met.
nurseOversight: Provide intensive nursing oversight; review each shift and evaluate MLR, DT-013, DT-014 and service capability. Set resident-specific monitoring parameters from current orders; interpret trends and manage change-of-condition escalation.

activationRule: Recommend only when the assessed need is active and requires staff action; nurse individualizes and approves before activation.

Report observed confusion, missed doses or adverse symptoms.

activationRule: Recommend only when the assessed need is active and requires staff action; nurse individualizes and approves before activation.

Confirm resident has taken medication when supervision is part of plan.
Maintain consistent medication timing around resident routine.
Document refusals, omissions or unusual effects.
nurseOversight: Confirm the individualized plan and review recurring exceptions. Complete medication reconciliation and MAR oversight; verify administration support, effectiveness, adverse effects and prescriber follow-up.

activationRule: Recommend only when the assessed need is active and requires staff action; nurse individualizes and approves before activation.

Check the right resident/medication/time/route per medication policy.
Monitor for side effects, sedation, dizziness or behavior/cognition change.
Report refusals, omissions, PRN patterns and concerns to nurse/provider.

activationRule: Recommend only when the assessed need is active and requires staff action; nurse individualizes and approves before activation.

Coordinate time-critical medications, monitoring and meals as ordered.
Track PRN use/response and high-risk side effects.
Ensure changes after hospital/clinic visits are reconciled before implementation.

activationRule: Recommend only when the assessed need is active and requires staff action; nurse individualizes and approves before activation.

Use explicit escalation pathway for missed critical doses, reactions or clinical instability.

activationRule: Recommend only when the assessed need is active and requires staff action; nurse individualizes and approves before activation.

Follow prescribed diet texture/diet modifications if present.
Document persistent poor intake or new food difficulty.

activationRule: Recommend only when the assessed need is active and requires staff action; nurse individualizes and approves before activation.

Offer nutrient-dense preferred foods and fluids within diet orders.

activationRule: Recommend only when the assessed need is active and requires staff action; nurse individualizes and approves before activation.

defaultGoal: Improve or maintain nutritional and hydration status through frequent individualized support for intake, weight or swallowing concerns.

Follow prescribed texture, positioning and swallowing precautions.
Track weight/intake/hydration trends and tolerance to supplements.
Coordinate clinical/dietitian/speech review for unresolved concerns.

Monitor tolerance, hydration, weight and signs of aspiration closely.

activationRule: Recommend only when the assessed need is active and requires staff action; nurse individualizes and approves before activation.

activationRule: Recommend only when the assessed need is active and requires staff action; nurse individualizes and approves before activation.

activationRule: Recommend only when the assessed need is active and requires staff action; nurse individualizes and approves before activation.

Anticipate needs and confirm through gestures, behavior and context.
